code:
git clone https://github.com/your-username/cs357-skills.git ~/.agents/skills/cs357
# or, for one project only:
git clone https://github.com/your-username/cs357-skills.git .agents/skills/cs357
description: Two clone commands that install a published skills repository into a discovery path, for every project or for one project.

steps.description: A classmate installs your published bundle by cloning it into a discovery path. The directory is the whole installation.
The `~/.agents/skills/cs357` path is global, so the bundle is available in every project.
The project path installs the bundle for one project, which is the one a reviewer can clone and check.

steps.question: The directory name is the skill name. Which front matter field must it match?

title: Cloning a Published Skill Bundle
